[size=6][b]Documentation:[/b][/size][/center]
[i](Leah always has post event dialogue. Some events have other villagers also have post event dialogue)[/i]

1 Heart Event:
[i](in the Forest; from 11:00am to 5:00pm;[i] sunny[/i])[/i]
[SPOILER][b]The Artist Girl:[/b]
You encounters Leah sketching by the pond.
She’s startled but invites you to sit with her.
You share a brief conversation about art and nature.
Leah gives the player a small sketch as a keepsake. (play to find out more)[/SPOILER]

2 Heart Event:
[i](in Leah's home; anytime; event 1 had to be seen)[/i]
[SPOILER][b]Painting together:[/b]
Leah is painting in her cottage when you arrives.
She invites you to learn some art skills or techniques. 
Depending on what you pick you can get a cool or okay painting. (play to find out more)[/SPOILER]

3 Heart Event:
[i]([i]a[i]t the Beach[/i][/i]; from 10:00am to 5:00pm; sunny; event 2 had to be seen)[/i]
[SPOILER][b]Collecting together:[/b]
Leah is collecting seashells for her art.
You helps her gather them.
You talk about Leah's dreams and passions.
Leah opens up about why she moved to Pelican Town and shares her hopes for the future. (play to find out more)[/SPOILER]

4 Heart Event:
[i](at the Bus Stop[i]; from 9:00am to 1:00pm;[/i] event 3 had to be seen)[/i]
[SPOILER][b]The art show:[/b]
Leah excitedly tells you she’s been invited to showcase her work in a local gallery.
She invites you to come with her for support as Elliott is unavailable at the last minute.
At the gallery, Leah encounters her old art teacher, who always told her she would never succeed as an artist.
The teacher mocks Leah, and she becomes upset, asking you to leave early with her. (play to find out more)[/SPOILER]

5 Heart Event:
[i](in Leah's home; anytime; event 4 had to be seen)[/i]
[SPOILER][b]Artist Block:[/b]
Leah is struggling with a severe case of artist's block.
She tells you about her unsupportive art teacher and how most people in her life never supported her artistic ambitions. (play to find out more)[/SPOILER]

6 Heart Event:[i]
(in the Museum/Library; from 8:00am to 2:00pm; event 5 had to be seen)
(Elliott will also comment on this event)[/i]
[SPOILER][b]No Inspiration:[/b]
You find Leah in the library, almost breaking down, as she struggles to find inspiration.
You can suggest either a nature walk or a hangout at the bar to help her relax.
[b][color=#dd7e6b]Depending on what you suggest you will have a completely different 7 Heart Event[/color][/b] (play to find out more)[/SPOILER]

7 Heart Event:
[i](Depending on what you picked in the last Event; you will only get either Event 7a or 7b)
﻿
﻿Event 7a:
﻿(in the Forest; from 10:00am to 4:00pm; sunny; [i]event 6 had to be seen; picked the nature option[/i])[/i]
﻿[SPOILER][b]Nature Walk:[/b]
﻿If you chose the nature walk, you will encounter a friendly fox with Leah.
﻿Leah compares herself to the fox, living independently and not needing to prove anything to others. (play to find out more)[/SPOILER]
[i] ﻿
﻿Event 7b:
﻿(in the Town; from 8:00pm to 11:00pm; [i]event 6 had to be seen; picked the hangout option[/i])[/i]
﻿[SPOILER][b]Saloon Hangout:[/b]
﻿If you chose the Saloon hangout, Leah will finds comfort in the Saloon community, observing how the townspeople have their own lives and struggles.
﻿This inspires her not to feel down. (play to find out more)[/SPOILER]

8 Heart Event:[i]
(in the Forest; from 10:00am to 4:00pm; sunny; event 7a or 7b had to be seen)[/i]
[SPOILER][b]Confessing is an Art:[/b]
Leah asks you to talk.
She tells you that life is going well lately.
She asks how you feels about her (romance or friends), and she is okay with either.
[b][color=#dd7e6b]Depending on what you pick Leah's story will continue as Lovers or Friends[/color][/b] (play to find out more)[/SPOILER]

9 Heart Event:
[i](in the Mayor's House; from 8:00am to 1:00pm; event 8 had to be seen)
[i](Lewis will also comment on this event)[/i][/i]
[SPOILER][b]What are they planning?:[/b]
You walk in on Leah planning something with Mayor Lewis.
And vaguely asks about a motive for something.
Pick between: Classic, Cool or Silly.
Silly is my personal favorite. (play to find out more)[/SPOILER]

10 Heart Event:[i]
(in the Town; from 8:00am to 3:00pm; sunny; event 9 had to be seen)[/i]
[SPOILER][b]Painting a New Future Together:[/b]
Leah invites you to paint a city mural together, with permission from the mayor to beautify the town.
Depending on what you picked in the last Event the motive will look different.
This will permanently change the town’s appearance. (play to find out more)[/SPOILER]

[size=6][b]Frequently asked questions:[/b]
[/size]
[b][u]Q:[/u][/b] Is the mod compatible with [color=#f1c232][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753][color=#f1c232]Stardew Valley Expanded[/color][/url]﻿[/color]?
[b][u]A:[/u][/b] [color=#6aa84f]Yes![/color] The events account for if Stardew Expanded is installed or not.

[b][u]Q:[/u][/b] Can I stay [color=#ffd966]platonic friends[/color] with Leah after 8 Hearts?
[b][u]A:[/u][/b] [color=#6aa84f]Yes! [/color]Yes in the 8 heart event you will be able to pick to continue as friends or romance.

[b][u]Q:[/u][/b] Will the [color=#ffd966]Vanilla Stardew Events[/color] with Leah be [color=#ffd966]replaced[/color]?
[b][u]A:[/u][/b] [color=#cc0000]No![/color][color=#6aa84f] [/color]This mod only [b]adds[/b] more events and does not change any existing events.
     Story wise the Events do not align with the Vanilla events

[b][u]Q:[/u][/b] Is the mod compatible with[color=#f1c232] any other Leah story mod[/color]﻿?
[b][u]A:[/u][/b] [color=#6aa84f]Yes! [/color]This mod only [b]adds[/b] more events and does not change anything about Leah.
     Not sure if the stories will always fit.

[b][u]Q:[/u][/b] Can I make a [color=#f1c232]translation[/color] for this mod?
[b][u]A:[/u][/b] [color=#6aa84f]Yes![/color] I am really thankful for any translation.
     Please read the permissions and credits tab first! (no AI).
     Please make sure to use the correct i18n format.
     If you want to use the artwork for your translation or other mod, make sure to credit the original artist.

[b][u]Q:[/u][/b] Can I use your [color=#f1c232]assets[/color]?
[b][u]A:[/u] [/b]Short answer is [color=#cc0000]no.[/color] But you can reach out to me on Discord to ask for permission (username: [url=https://discordapp.com/users/311172683679268865/]Miihau[/url]).
     Portrait and Sprite of the art teacher are made by [url=https://linktr.ee/fejamas][color=#b6d7a8]FeJamasArt[/color][/url]. So they will also need to give you permission to use them.

[u][b]Q:[/b][/u] Is this mod compatible with [color=#f1c232]mobile[/color]?
[b][u]A:[/u][/b] [color=#6aa84f]I think so?[/color][color=#cc0000] [/color]Please make sure to use the latest version or SMAPI and Content Patcher for Stardew Valley 1.6.

Q: Can I still see the events if I'm [color=#f1c232]already married[/color] to Leah (or on an already existing save file)?
A: [color=#6aa84f]Yes![/color] You can still see all the event in the intended order.

[u][b]Q:[/b][/u] Will Leah's [color=#f1c232]behavior change[/color]?
[u][b]A:[/b][/u][color=#cc0000] No! [/color]This mod does not change her behavior (schedule, gift taste, etc.).

[u][b]Q:[/b][/u] Can I use your mod as a [color=#f1c232]template to learn[/color]?
[u][b]A:[/b][/u] [color=#6aa84f]Sure[/color], feel free to learn from it. Just don't blatantly copy whole chunks.

[u][b]Q:[/b][/u] Will you make a [color=#f1c232]mod for [insert your favorite NPC here][/color]?
[u][b]A:[/b][/u] So far I have mods for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17674][color=#d5a6bd][u]Haley[/u][/color][/url]﻿,[color=#f4cccc][b] [/b][/color][color=#8e7cc3][b][u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18657][color=#8e7cc3]Abigail[/color][/url]﻿[/u][/b][/color], [color=#f6b26b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16279][u]Penny[/u][/url]﻿[/color] and [color=#1e84cc][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24068][color=#1e84cc][u]Shane[/u][/color][/url][/color].
     I really want to make a mod for all the NPCs, but currently I have my eye on [color=#f1c232]Sam[/color].
     You can vote for you I mod next on my [url=https://miihau.com/home/?tab=modvotebtn]Website[/url].
